Dear Miss Yonge,                                                                   Oct 26 1866

[Mr Williams](/person/1964) of [W. & Norgate](/organisation/165) tells me that reserved rights which are made [illegible]  [illegible]  [illegible]  are for twelve months after publication cease to exist and [illegible]  [illegible] copyright treaty was only made in 1853 so you are quite safe in all aspects.

I shall be very glad to hear the results of your consultation with [Miss Sewell](/person/1301), and hope very much that something really valuable can come of your [Extracts](/periodical/71). I should be rather glad to have a sketch of the whole scheme and a bit of the extracts when you have leisure [sic].

Also Pr[illegible] look with interest for [illegible]  parents, [illegible]

Very faithfully yours

[Alex. Macmillan](/person/939)
